# My Entry

Today was a *good* day.

note: contract change: POST /api/export/pdf now requires auth. It was unauthenticated through the whole Flask era and was kept that way for parity until 2026-08-17, when the rule gained the AuthUser extractor (see contract/DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-17, and SECURITY.md — this closes the old risk-accepted follow-up). No credentials at all -> 401 before any body validation, with the same body every require_auth rule returns. A cookie-authenticated call must also carry Content-Type: application/json + X-Requested-With: nightlio or it takes the standard CSRF 403 {"error": "Missing required request header"}; Bearer callers bypass CSRF. Still no rate limit: with auth required, request-volume abuse is an authenticated user's self-harm.
